subject.title: fix(agents): guard provider tool diagnostic names

question: Should this narrow unreadable-name diagnostic guard land as its own PR, or be folded into a broader provider diagnostics hardening branch?
rationale: The patch is locally correct, but multiple open maintainer drafts change the same helper or adjacent SDK hardening surface, and automation cannot choose the intended canonical behavior for operators.

options.title: Choose A Canonical Diagnostics Branch
options.body: Pick the branch that should own final provider diagnostics behavior and fold this guard into that branch before merge.

options.title: Land This Narrow Guard Deliberately
options.body: Merge this PR first only if maintainers explicitly accept that broader descriptor, inspector-failure, sanitization, and SDK traversal work remains in sibling drafts.

options.title: Pause Until A Sibling Resolves
options.body: Keep this draft open until a broader sibling lands or is rejected, then re-check whether this branch still has unique value.

recommendation.title: Choose A Canonical Diagnostics Branch
recommendation.body: Pick the branch that should own final provider diagnostics behavior and fold this guard into that branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns this PR and the overlapping provider diagnostics hardening drafts, so they are the best routing point for canonical-branch selection.
